Package index

Module 1 — Environmental classification (enviromics)

Retrieve and quality-control weather, soil, management, and geography data; build and combine environment kernels; calibrate a data-driven environmental covariance; and cluster sites into mega-environments.

build_enviromic_covariates()
Assemble enviromic covariates for sites (weather, soil, management)
fetch_weather_series()
Fetch a daily weather series from NASA POWER
calibrate_weather_series()
Bias-correct gridded weather with on-station observations
fetch_soilgrids()
Retrieve SoilGrids soil properties at site coordinates
soil_profile_features()
Summarise multi-depth SoilGrids predictions over the crop root zone
enviromic_variable_catalog()
Catalogue of enviromic variable names, descriptions and units
envirotype_features()
Temporal envirotyping features from a daily weather series
rice_weather_features()
Rice-focused weather and crop-stress envirotyping
historical_envirotype()
Characterise candidate sites from past seasons (planning-stage envirotyping)
assess_envirotype_stability()
Assess whether the environment relationship is stable across years
qc_environmental_data()
Quality-control environmental source data
build_environment_kernels()
Build separate environmental kernels by information modality
add_environment_kernel_interactions()
Add functional-ANOVA interaction kernels
combine_environment_kernels()
Combine modality-specific environmental kernels
consensus_environment_kernels()
Weight-free consensus of environmental kernels
build_variable_interaction_kernels()
Build dedicated variable-level environmental interaction kernels
assess_variable_interactions()
Assess dedicated environmental interactions with historical MET evidence
calibrate_environment_covariance()
Calibrate environmental covariance from historical MET information
build_environment_relationship()
Build one environment relationship matrix for exploratory selection
cluster_environments()
Partition environments into a specified number of mega-environments
infer_mega_environments()
Infer stable mega-environments without specifying their number
select_environments()
Select a representative subset of environments from a TPE (decision 1)
screen_interactions()
Screen environmental covariates/interactions by variance explained in G x E
list_candidate_interactions()
Enumerate candidate interaction terms among covariates
agronomic_interaction_hypotheses()
Curated agronomic interaction hypotheses
add_management_interactions()
Build management interaction covariates
nest_dose_within_type()
Nest management doses within their type (fertiliser, pesticide, irrigation)

Module 2 — Genetic relationship matrices

Construct and condition genomic, hybrid/testcross (with optional dominance), and consensus relationship matrices, and make them invertible for downstream prediction.

build_relationship_matrix()
Build a relationship matrix from markers, pedigree, or both
build_hybrid_relationship()
Genomic relationship among hybrids/testcrosses from parental G
combine_relationship_matrices()
Combine relationship matrices (e.g. additive + dominance) for total merit
tune_relationship_matrix()
Make a relationship matrix well-conditioned and invertible
kinship_pca()
Principal components of a kinship/relationship matrix
consensus_relationship()
Robust consensus of several relationship matrices

Module 3 — Sparse allocation across environments

Distribute treatments across environments (M3 random-balanced and M4 equireplicate), verify feasibility and capacity, and choose the number and identity of connecting common treatments.

allocate_sparse_met()
Allocate test treatments across environments for sparse MET designs
check_balanced_incomplete_feasibility() check_equireplicate_feasibility()
Evaluate feasibility of an exact equireplicate sparse MET allocation
construct_exact_bibd()
Construct an exact balanced incomplete block design (when one exists)
derive_allocation_groups()
Derive allocation group labels for sparse MET treatment assignment
optimize_allocation_gxe()
Optimise entry-across-environment allocation for G x E prediction (decision 3)
feasibility_helpers
Feasibility helpers for sparse MET allocation
min_k_for_full_coverage()
Compute the minimum per-environment capacity for full treatment coverage
suggest_safe_k()
Suggest a safe uniform per-environment capacity for sparse MET allocation
warn_if_k_too_small()
Warn when per-environment capacity is insufficient for full treatment coverage
suggest_common_range()
Suggest a range of common-treatment counts to evaluate
recommend_common_treatments()
Recommend the number of common treatments from environmental kinship
suggest_common_treatments()
Fast heuristic screen for common (connectivity) treatments
optimize_common_treatments()
Robustly optimise a common-treatment set
tune_common_treatments()
Tune the number of common treatments across environments
suggest_site_capacity()
Suggest the optimal number of plots for an unconstrained site
test_entry_capacity()
Test-entry capacity of an offered plot budget
required_plots()
Total plots required for a number of test entries
field_plot_accounting()
Field plot accounting (checks, entries, replication)

Module 4 — Seed-aware replication

Turn a single network-wide seed inventory and per-plot seed requirements into a feasible per-site replication plan.

assign_replication_by_seed()
Classify treatments into replication roles based on seed availability
recommend_replication()
Recommend a replication level from accuracy, cost, and seed constraints (decision 4)

Module 5 — Within-environment field design

Construct and optimise within-site layouts (block-based repeated-check and alpha row-column), evaluate their statistical efficiency, and compare spatial error models.

met_prep_famoptg()
Construct a repeated-check block design with flexible replication
met_alpha_rc_stream()
Construct a stream-based repeated-check alpha row-column design
met_optimize_famoptg()
Search for a criterion-optimal repeated-check block design
met_optimize_alpha_rc()
Search for a criterion-optimal alpha-lattice design
met_evaluate_famoptg_efficiency()
Evaluate the statistical efficiency of a repeated-check block design
met_evaluate_alpha_efficiency()
Evaluate the statistical efficiency of an alpha-lattice design
compare_spatial_models()
Score one design under several spatial models

Module 6 — Coupled optimisation & information

The two-level (allocation x local-efficiency) information matrix, exact multi-trait index reliability, criterion + gain + cost objectives, exchange/simulated-annealing optimisation, robust/CVaR scoring, and the Pareto trade-off frontier.

met_information()
Across-environment (MET-level) information matrix and prediction reliability
met_information_mt()
Exact multi-trait MET information matrix (trait-covariance Kronecker term)
design_objective()
Evaluate a sparse MET design under a combined objective
optimize_design()
Criterion-driven optimisation of a sparse MET allocation
robust_scenarios()
Build a prior over variance components for robust design
robust_design_score()
Robust (Bayesian / maximin / CVaR) score of a design over a prior
pareto_designs()
Trade-off (Pareto) frontier of designs over benefit vs cost
plot_pareto_frontier()
Plot a cost-minimisation Pareto frontier
selection_intensity()
Standardised selection intensity
expected_genetic_gain()
Expected genetic gain of a design
desired_gain_weights()
Multi-trait index weights from desired genetic gains
sensitivity_varcomp()
Variance-component sensitivity of a MET design (P3.5)
validate_design_criteria()
Validate design-stage criteria against realised selection outcomes
fa_sigma_e()
Factor-analytic environment covariance
select_individuals()
Select a representative training subset of the TPG by CDmean (decision 2)
sparsity_grid()
Explore the sparse-testing trade-off (individuals x per-environment x environments)

Module 7 — Simulation

Monte-Carlo genotype-by-environment simulation of realised prediction accuracy, selection gain, and top-fraction coincidence for a design.

simulate_met()
Simulate a sparse MET and report realised accuracy and genetic gain

Module 8 — Benchmarking & empirical validation

Paired comparison of reference designs (complete / random / M3 / M4 / optimised) with confidence intervals, tail risk (CVaR), and decision stability; plus known-truth covariance recovery and missing-data stress tests on the enviromic side.

make_met_benchmark_designs()
Construct reference designs for sparse MET benchmarking
benchmark_met_designs()
Benchmark MET designs under statistical and operational uncertainty
benchmark_environment_models()
Benchmark environmental covariance models against response evidence
simulate_environment_model_benchmark()
Simulate recovery of a known environmental covariance
benchmark_environment_missingness()
Stress-test environmental kernels under missing covariates
summarize_design_stability()
Summarise stability of repeated MET design decisions

Module 9 — Pipeline, field books & data

End-to-end orchestration, assembly of per-site field books into a single combined MET field book, and the bundled example dataset.

plan_sparse_met_design()
Plan a sparse multi-environment trial design and assemble a combined field book
run_design_strategy()
Run the sparse-MET decision-point framework end to end
combine_met_fieldbooks()
Combine environment-level field books into a single MET field book
OptiSparseMET_example_data
Example data for OptiSparseMET
